assignment.display_position_topology_balance: within each of 24 display positions across 40 slots, every topology appears exactly 10 times
assignment.left_right_balance: within every slot x topology: exactly 3 V9-favored-side-left and 3 V9-favored-side-right
assignment.randomization_method: ten random 24-position base topology sequences, each containing six of every topology; each base is expanded to four slots using a cyclic topology-label rotation. Challenges are independently seed-shuffled within topology and consumed once.

catalog.generator: exact B7 witness-1 source-frame generator and zero-objective Tier-C MILP
catalog.reason_candidate_predictions_are_used: The frozen estimand is conditional on true V9 vs V1.7 non-fair verdict discordance.

frozen_outcome_evaluator.estimand: theta_t = P(manager chooses V9 verdict | V9 and V1.7 give opposite non-fair verdicts, topology t)
frozen_outcome_evaluator.estimator: direct LPM intercept with centered left/right covariate
frozen_outcome_evaluator.estimator_implementation: guarded B6 cluster_lpm, general scalar form
frozen_outcome_evaluator.left_covariate: +1 iff V9-favored side was displayed left; -1 otherwise
frozen_outcome_evaluator.log_loss: secondary only; cannot activate or rescue a topology
frozen_outcome_evaluator.multiplicity: Holm step-down across exactly m=4 retained topologies
frozen_outcome_evaluator.outcome: 1 iff canonical human choice equals the frozen V9-favored side for that challenge
frozen_outcome_evaluator.reference_distribution: Student t with G-1 degrees of freedom
frozen_outcome_evaluator.topology_router: each retained topology activates independently; non-activated retained topologies and all 2v2/2v4 remain V1.7

purpose: Regenerate the exact B7-bound witness-1 catalog, persist the 960 human challenges, freeze a 40-slot balanced assignment, and freeze the later human-outcome evaluator before any voting begins.

response_eligibility.accepted_session_per_slot: the complete session with the earliest final-vote timestamp; if complete sessions tie on final-vote timestamp, the lexicographically smallest session_id wins; every other session for that slot (partial or complete, earlier or later) is excluded and recorded
response_eligibility.all_exclusions_outcome_blind: every eligibility decision above uses only identifiers, timestamps, schedule consistency and completeness, never the choice made
response_eligibility.complete_session: a valid session containing exactly one vote for each of its slot's 24 challenges
response_eligibility.maturity: analysis opens only when all 40 slots have exactly one accepted session (960 rows); no early opening
response_eligibility.replacement: a replacement voter receives the identical slot URL and a new session_id; no challenge moves between slots
response_eligibility.row_validity: a row is valid only if its challenge_id belongs to its slot schedule, canonical_left equals the frozen schedule display_left for that slot/challenge, display_order equals the frozen position, clicked_display_L_or_R is consistent with canonical_choice and canonical_left, and utc_iso8601_timestamp is a parseable UTC timestamp
response_eligibility.session_validity: a session is invalid if any row is invalid, if it contains rows for more than one slot, or if any challenge is voted more than once within the session
response_eligibility.voter_eligibility: one person per slot; people who have seen V9 research artifacts, model verdicts or this study design (including the project owner and reviewers) are ineligible
response_eligibility.voter_instruction: judge each trade on your own dynasty valuation without consulting any trade calculator or value chart

transport_contract.session_id_rule: random >=128-bit identifier generated client-side when a slot session starts; never reused across sessions or slots
transport_contract.timestamp_rule: utc_iso8601_timestamp is recorded for every vote row and must parse as UTC; session final-vote timestamp is the maximum valid row timestamp; exact ties are resolved by lexicographic session_id as frozen in response_eligibility
